Immutable Record Layer

Transparent Access to Verified Climate Data

Alethia’s blockchain-secured registry marks a new era in climate data integrity—offering stakeholders transparent access to verified, immutable records.

01 Tamper-Proof by Design

Each dataset is cryptographically sealed and time-stamped the moment it's recorded—creating a permanent, immutable record of carbon performance.

02 Full Chain of Custody

Alethia’s public ledger captures every step—from initial observation to final claim—ensuring transparent tracking across the full data lifecycle.
